title: Building Trust in Clinical LLMs: Bias Analysis and Dataset Transparency

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using two approaches: 1) Sentiment analysis of model-generated text completions prompted by the BOLD dataset's race category, and 2) Comparing the probabilities of prescribing opioid and non-opioid pain medications (Net Bias Prescription Score) across different ethnic groups using counterfactual variations of clinical cases.

Evaluated via sentiment analysis of generated completions using gender-specific prompts from the BOLD dataset, and by calculating overprescription and underprescription rates of pain medications using clinical scenarios with gender-swapped terms.

Assessed in the healthcare domain by measuring differential prescription tendencies (probability ratios of prescribing specific pain medications) across different age groups using adapted clinical case prompts.
